features.introFirst.zh: 少一点在工具之间切换，

features.introSecond.zh: 多一点对问题本身的思考。
features.introSecond.en: More time thinking about the question.

features.researchBody.zh: 用自然语言描述目标。Agent 调用数据和量化工具，把分析过程与结果留在同一段对话里。
features.researchBody.en: Describe your goal in natural language. The agent calls data and quantitative tools, keeping the analysis and results in the same conversation.

features.backtestTitle.en: Put an idea to the test

features.backtestBody.zh: 从动量、波动率到双均线策略，用因子、回测与风险指标检验想法，并查看数据覆盖。
features.backtestBody.en: From momentum and volatility to moving-average strategies, test ideas with factors, backtests and risk metrics. Check the data coverage along the way.

features.reportsBody.zh: 在设置中开启报告生成，用 Dashboard 看结果，用 Trajectory 回看工具调用和研究过程。
features.reportsBody.en: Enable report generation in settings. Use Dashboard to review results and Trajectory to revisit tool calls and the research process.

settings.intro.en: Connect models, manage data sources and adjust your workspace with /config in the terminal. Make the tools fit the way you research.

settings.colorNotice.zh: 涨跌配色只影响行情。回撤风险与操作状态保持各自语义。
settings.colorNotice.en: Market colors apply to price movements. Drawdown risk and action status keep their own meanings.

settings.modelHelp.en: Choose a provider and model ID in the terminal

settings.thinkingHelp.zh: 选择模型支持的推理级别
settings.thinkingHelp.en: Choose a reasoning level supported by your model

settings.verifyHelp.zh: 保存连接并发送小型验证请求
settings.verifyHelp.en: Save the connection and send a small verification request

settings.credentialsNotice.en: Enter credentials in the installed terminal. This website does not collect API keys.

settings.dataHelp.en: Choose a market, data source and sample window

settings.checkHelp.zh: 检查当前连接的样本响应
settings.checkHelp.en: Check a sample response from your connection

faq.tradingQuestion.zh: 这是一个在线交易平台吗？
faq.tradingQuestion.en: Is this an online trading platform?

faq.tradingAnswer.zh: WhyJ Quant 是安装在本机的量化研究终端。这是它的产品介绍与交互演示页面；网页不连接证券账户，也不执行交易。
faq.tradingAnswer.en: WhyJ Quant is a quantitative research terminal installed on your computer. This website introduces the product and demonstrates its interface. It does not connect to brokerage accounts or execute trades.

faq.providersQuestion.zh: 需要自己配置模型和数据源吗？
faq.providersQuestion.en: Do I configure my own model and data sources?

faq.providersAnswer.zh: 需要。在 /config 中选择模型连接与适合研究市场的数据源。部分数据源需要 API key，AKShare 路径需要本机 Python 环境和相应依赖。模型和数据服务费用由各提供方收取。
faq.providersAnswer.en: Yes. Use /config to select a model connection and data sources for your markets. Some sources require an API key. AKShare requires a local Python environment and its dependencies. Model and data providers charge for their own services.

faq.storageAnswer.zh: 配置、研究会话与报告保存在本地工作区。分析时会向你选择的模型和数据提供方发送必要请求；本地存储不等于所有计算都离线。官网仅在浏览器保存演示偏好。
faq.storageAnswer.en: Configuration, research sessions and reports are stored in your local workspace. Analysis sends necessary requests to your chosen model and data providers; local storage does not mean all computation is offline. This website only saves demo preferences in your browser.

faq.contributeQuestion.en: How can I give feedback or contribute?

faq.contributeFirst.en: The project is MIT licensed. Visit

faq.contributeSecond.zh: 阅读代码、提出问题或提交改进。界面能力以所安装版本和配置为准。
faq.contributeSecond.en: to read the code, report issues or contribute improvements. Available features depend on your installed version and configuration.
